scope: Synthesis of the latest CASF/C3 interpretation against existing CASF v2, C3 hardening, side-stream, and role-audit artifacts.
current_thesis: The remaining compressible structure is chart-local and online-referential, not primarily corpus-global and vocabulary-based.

as: future auxiliary-target, emitted-target-grammar, or two-stage-plan candidate

not_proved: end-to-end mapper loss or generation quality improvement
legal production input conditioning from target-derived sidecar tokens
surfaced_issues: C3 is side-stream-shaped and often noncontiguous in the main stream.
Many selected spans cross chunk/window boundaries.
The P0 side-stream artifact is lossless but larger than the baseline encoded stream.
Current pooled C3 conditioning consumes target-derived labels and is not a legal inference input.
Later auxiliary/kind diagnostics have not yet shown enough RAW-side learnability for full integration.
audit_target: Can C3's chart-local fallback reference structure be turned into a legal mapper-side target or auxiliary target without target leakage, while preserving deterministic reconstruction and acceptable sequence/state cost?
kill_or_defer: broad global vocabulary expansion as the next answer
next_bounded_direction: Keep v3 as the current simpler teacher-forcing target-grammar route.
Preserve C3 as a codec-side and target-side representation family.
Revisit C3 through auxiliary target, emitted target grammar, or a two-stage predicted C3 plan only after a bounded card defines legal decode path and metrics.
